```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

class TodoDetail extends Component
{
    public $todoId;
    public $title;
    public $completed = false;

    public function mount($todoId)
    {
        $this->todoId = $todoId;
        // Fetch the todo from the database or API and set it to properties.
    }

    public function save()
    {
        $response = Http::put("/api/todos/{$this->todoId}", ['title' => $this->title, 'completed' => $this->completed]);
        if ($response->status() === 200) {
            // Update the local property with the new data.
            $this->title = $response->json()->title;
            $this->completed = $response->json()->completed;
        }
    }

    public function delete()
    {
        Http::delete("/api/todos/{$this->todoId}");
        // Remove the todo from the local array or database.
    }
}
```
